item.title: Node.js Job Queue Libraries: BullMQ vs Bee-Queue vs pg-boss — Complete Comparison
item.description: Background job processing is fundamental to modern Node.js applications. Whether you are sending emails, generating reports, processing uploaded files, or running scheduled tasks, a reliable job queue ensures these operations happen reliably without blocking your HTTP request cycle.
